title: A Non-intrusive Approach for the Imposition of Strong Dirichlet Boundary Conditions in Unfitted Boundary Meshes
abstract: arXiv:2609.15398v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The enforcement of essential boundary conditions is a fundamental challenge in unfitted boundary methods. This paper presents a non-intrusive, black-box strategy for imposing such conditions in unfitted meshes. The approach is intended for situations where the user does not have access to the solver's source code or its mathematical formulation, which is often the case when using commercial software. The proposed algorithm allows solvers originally designed for body-fitted meshes to be used in unfitted cases, provided that four conditions are satisfied: (i) the solver must support user customization by means of scripting, (ii) allow the imposition of Dirichlet boundary conditions at the node level through scripting, (iii) permit the deactivation of elements outside the physical domain, and (iv) provide access to the solution gradient within active elements. translated_title: 一种在非贴合边界网格中施加强狄利克雷边界条件的非侵入式方法
translated_abstract: 本质边界条件的施加是非贴合边界方法中的一项基本挑战。本文提出了一种非侵入式的黑盒策略，用于在非贴合网格中施加此类边界条件。该方法适用于用户无法访问求解器源代码或其数学表述的情况，这在使用商业软件时尤为常见。所提出的算法使得原本为贴合网格设计的求解器能够在非贴合情况下使用，前提是满足以下四个条件：（i）求解器必须支持通过脚本进行用户自定义；（ii）允许通过脚本在节点级别施加狄利克雷边界条件；（iii）允许停用物理域外的单元；（iv）提供对活动单元内解的梯度的访问。最后一个条件也可以通过在外部重构梯度的方式来满足。
tldr: 本文提出一种非侵入式黑盒方法，使原本针对贴合网格设计的求解器在无需访问源代码的情况下，即可在非贴合网格中施加强狄利克雷边界条件。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a non-intrusive black-box strategy that enables solvers originally designed for body-fitted meshes to impose strong Dirichlet boundary conditions on unfitted meshes without requiring access to the solver's source code.
